spawning.purpose: Central plugin managing all NPC spawning: world-based environment spawning, beacon-based proximity spawning, and spawn marker placement. Registers all ECS components, systems, asset stores, and commands for the spawning subsystem. Maintains WorldSpawnManager and BeaconSpawnManager as the two top-level spawn orchestrators.
spawning.overview: The spawning system has three main spawn modes: (1) World spawning — environment-driven density-based NPC population across chunks, (2) Beacon spawning — player-proximity triggered spawn points with configurable cooldowns, and (3) Spawn markers — fixed-location respawning NPCs with deactivation/reactivation. All modes share a common SpawningContext for collision/position validation and integrate with the flock system for group spawning.

spawn_rules.overview: Spawn rules are defined via JSON-configured assets (WorldNPCSpawn, BeaconNPCSpawn, SpawnMarker). Each config specifies: which NPCs to spawn (RoleSpawnParameters with weighted probabilities), environmental conditions (day/night range, moon phase, light levels per type), spawn/despawn parameters, and block/fluid constraints.

condition_types.name: DayTimeRange
condition_types.purpose: Hour range (0-24) for spawn eligibility. Can be scaled to world's DaytimePortion via ScaleDayTimeRange flag.

condition_types.name: MoonPhaseRange
condition_types.purpose: Moon phase range (0-4, where 0=full moon, 4=new moon). 5 phases in Hytale.

condition_types.name: LightRanges
condition_types.purpose: Per-light-type ranges (0-100). Types: Light, SkyLight, Sunlight, RedLight, GreenLight, BlueLight

condition_types.name: MoonPhaseWeightModifiers
condition_types.purpose: Per-moon-phase multipliers (0-2) for spawn weights. Array of 5 values.

condition_types.name: SpawnBlockSet
condition_types.purpose: Restricts which blocks the NPC can spawn on

condition_types.name: SpawnFluidTag
condition_types.purpose: Restricts which fluids the NPC can spawn on/in

despawn_conditions.purpose: NPCs spawned by a config will be despawned when the world enters the despawn time/phase range. Overpopulation check: if actual > expected * 1.25 + 4 buffer, NPCs are despawned.

spawn_markers.overview: Fixed-location spawners placed in the world. Each marker references a SpawnMarker asset that defines a weighted pool of NPC configurations. When an NPC dies, the marker respawns after a cooldown (real-time or game-time). Markers deactivate when no players are within DeactivationDistance and store their NPCs as StoredFlock.
key_classes: SpawnMarkerEntity — ECS component holding marker state
SpawnMarker — JSON asset defining marker configuration
SpawnMarkerSystems — Add/tick/deactivation logic
SpawnMarkerBlockState — Block-based variant

marker_config_fields.NPCs: Weighted list of SpawnConfiguration (NPC role, weight, respawn timers, flock)
marker_config_fields.ExclusionRadius: Prevents spawning when adventure-mode player is within this radius
marker_config_fields.MaxDropHeight: Maximum ground distance below marker for spawn placement
marker_config_fields.RealtimeRespawn: Whether to use real-time or game-time for respawn
marker_config_fields.ManualTrigger: If true, marker must be explicitly triggered (via interaction or NPC action)
marker_config_fields.DeactivationDistance: Marker deactivates (stores NPCs) when no players are within range

spawn_configuration_fields.Name: NPC role name
spawn_configuration_fields.Flock: Optional FlockAsset reference for group spawning

lifecycle: 1. Marker entity loads, caches SpawnMarker asset
2. On tick: check deactivation distance, manage respawn timers
3. When ready to spawn: validate position via SpawningContext, check block types, light, breathing
4. Spawn NPC via NPCPlugin.spawnEntity(), optionally spawn flock via FlockPlugin.trySpawnFlock()
6. On deactivation: store NPCs as StoredFlock, restore on reactivation

spawn_beacons.overview: Dynamic or placed spawn points that create NPCs around nearby players. Two entity types exist: LegacySpawnBeaconEntity (full-featured, manages BeaconSpawnController) and SpawnBeacon (simplified, supports manual triggering). Beacons use FloodFillPositionSelector to find valid spawn positions within a radius.
key_classes: LegacySpawnBeaconEntity — Full beacon entity with spawn controller and timer management
SpawnBeacon — Simplified beacon with manual trigger support
BeaconNPCSpawn — JSON config for beacon spawning rules
BeaconSpawnController — Manages spawn rounds, player tracking, NPC limits
BeaconSpawnWrapper — Runtime wrapper around BeaconNPCSpawn with weighted role picker
NPCBeaconSpawnJob — Individual spawn job targeting a specific player

beacon_config_fields.Environments: Environments where this beacon can dynamically spawn
beacon_config_fields.TargetDistanceFromPlayer: Guideline distance for NPC spawn placement
beacon_config_fields.YRange: Vertical range offsets for spawn positions
beacon_config_fields.MaxSpawnedNPCs: Maximum concurrent NPCs from this beacon
beacon_config_fields.InitialSpawnDelayRange: Delay before first spawn after beacon creation
beacon_config_fields.NPCIdleDespawnTime: Seconds idle before despawning NPC (requires NPCSpawnState)
beacon_config_fields.BeaconVacantDespawnTime: Game-time before beacon self-despawns with no players
beacon_config_fields.NPCSpawnState: Force NPC into this state on spawn (e.g. 'Chase')
beacon_config_fields.TargetSlot: MarkedEntity slot to set the target player in
beacon_config_fields.SpawnSuppression: Optional suppression zone attached to this beacon
beacon_config_fields.MaxSpawnsScalingCurve: ResponseCurve scaling max NPCs by player count
beacon_config_fields.ConcurrentSpawnsScalingCurve: ResponseCurve scaling concurrent spawns by player count

spawn_flow: 1. Beacon entity loads, SpawnBeaconSystems initializes controller
2. ControllerTick: detect players in beacon radius via spatial query
3. Scale max spawns and concurrent spawns by player count via response curves
4. Check spawn timer (real-time or game-time instant-based)
7. Validate position, spawn NPC, set target slot and forced state
8. If flock configured, use FlockPlugin.trySpawnFlock() for group spawning
9. Track spawned entity, manage idle despawn timeouts

world_spawning.overview: Environment-driven density-based NPC spawning across loaded chunks. Each environment has a spawn density and associated WorldNPCSpawn configs. The WorldSpawningSystem selects chunks via a spiral iterator, creates SpawnJobs, and the WorldSpawnJobSystems process those jobs by scanning chunk columns for valid spawn positions.
key_classes: WorldSpawnManager — Manages WorldSpawnWrappers per environment, enforces unique NPC-environment combinations
WorldSpawnWrapper — Runtime wrapper around WorldNPCSpawn
EnvironmentSpawnParameters — Per-environment spawn density and wrapper list
WorldSpawnData — Global spawn tracking resource
WorldEnvironmentSpawnData — Per-environment actual/expected NPC counts
WorldNPCSpawnStat — Per-NPC-role spawn statistics
ChunkSpawnData — Per-chunk environment segment data
SpawnJobData — Per-chunk active spawn jobs

density_system.overview: Each Environment asset has a SpawnDensity value. The expected NPC count for an environment is: density * chunks_with_this_environment. Spawning continues until actual >= expected.
density_system.spiral_iterator: Chunks are selected via SpiralIterator from the world center outward
density_system.column_budget: Each tick has a column scanning budget of SpawnBudgetFactor * 20480

spawn_suppression.overview: System that prevents NPC spawning in configurable regions. Spawn suppressors are attached to entities and define a radius and set of suppressed NPC groups. The suppression controller maintains all active zones and provides SuppressionSpanHelper for Y-range adjustments during spawn position selection.
key_classes: SpawnSuppression — JSON asset defining suppression radius, NPC groups, and spawn marker suppression flag
SpawnSuppressionComponent — ECS component on suppressor entities
SpawnSuppressionController — Resource maintaining all active suppressors
ChunkSuppressionEntry — Per-chunk suppression zone data
ChunkSuppressionQueue — Processing queue for chunk suppression updates
SuppressionSpanHelper — Adjusts spawn Y-ranges to exclude suppressed vertical spans
SpawnSuppressorEntry — Individual suppression zone entry with position and radius

spawn_context.overview: SpawningContext is the central position validation mechanism shared by all spawn modes. It resolves a spawn position within a chunk column by analyzing spawn spans (contiguous empty blocks), checking ground level, water level, air height, block materials, and model bounding box fit.

key_fields.groundLevel: Y level of the ground block
key_fields.waterLevel: Y level of water surface (-1 if no water)
key_fields.airHeight: Y level of first air block above ground/water
key_fields.spawnModel: Model with bounding box for fit checks

validation_methods: isOnSolidGround() — checks for solid block beneath spawn position
isInWater(minDepth) — checks for sufficient water depth
isInAir(height) — checks for air spawn at given height

position_selection.overview: The FloodFillPositionSelector uses a flood-fill algorithm to discover valid spawn positions within a beacon's spawn radius. It maintains a cached set of positions per NPC role and rebuilds periodically.
key_classes: FloodFillPositionSelector — Main position cache and flood-fill algorithm
FloodFillEntryPoolProviderSimple — Object pool for flood fill entries
FloodFillEntryPoolSimple — Pool implementation
RandomChunkColumnIterator — Iterator that visits chunk columns in random order
ChunkColumnMask — Bitmask tracking visited columns within a chunk
util_classes: LightRangePredicate — Tests block light levels against spawn config ranges for all 6 light types

entity_factories.overview: Entity construction is delegated to NPCPlugin.spawnEntity() which creates NPC entities from role definitions. The spawning system provides position, rotation, model override (from SpawningContext), and post-spawn callbacks. Flock spawning is handled by FlockPlugin.trySpawnFlock() which spawns additional members around the leader.
spawn_chain: 1. SpawnWrapper.pickRole() selects a RoleSpawnParameters via weighted random
3. SpawningContext.setSpawnable() resolves model and bounding box
5. NPCPlugin.get().spawnEntity(store, roleIndex, position, rotation, model, postSpawn) creates the NPC
6. FlockPlugin.trySpawnFlock() optionally spawns additional flock members
7. Post-spawn callback sets spawn beacon reference, target slot, forced state

flock.purpose: Group behavior system for NPCs. Manages flock creation, membership (join/leave/leader election), group damage tracking, and provides NPC behavior components for flock-aware AI (steering, messaging, combat response, state management).
flock.overview: A flock is a runtime entity in the EntityStore composed of a Flock component, EntityGroup component, and UUIDComponent. Individual NPCs/players join via FlockMembership. Each flock has exactly one leader (elected or interim) and tracks group damage data via double-buffered DamageData. Flocks are configured via FlockAsset (JSON) which specifies size ranges, grow limits, and blocked roles. The flock plugin provides 10 NPC core component types for AI integration.

asset_stores.purpose: Flock definitions — size parameters, max grow size, blocked roles. Two sub-types: RangeSizeFlockAsset (min-max range) and WeightedSizeFlockAsset (weighted size distribution)

MaxGrowSize.purpose: Maximum flock size after initial spawning

BlockedRoles.purpose: Roles excluded from joining this flock post-spawn

Size.purpose: Random range for initial flock size (min, max inclusive)

SizeWeights.purpose: Weight array — index 0 = MinSize weight, index 1 = MinSize+1 weight, etc.

ecs_components_entity_store.purpose: Core flock component attached to the flock entity itself (not members). Contains PersistentFlockData, double-buffered DamageData for group and leader, removed status, and vis-flock debug counter.

ecs_components_entity_store.purpose: Persisted flock metadata — max grow size, allowed roles, current size. Stored on the leader NPC entity for chunk serialization and on the Flock entity at runtime.

NPC action to join or create a flock with target entity. Creates new flock if neither is in one.
NPC action to leave current flock. No-op if not in a flock.
Sets a state name (and optional substate) on all flock members, excluding the leader.
Sets or clears a locked target for all flock members via a named target slot.

Filters entities by flock membership status (Leader/Follower/Member/NotMember/Any), player membership, flock size range, and joinability.

flock_membership.overview: Entities join flocks via FlockMembershipSystems.join() which creates a FlockMembership component with JOINING type. The RefChange system processes the join: validates the entity (alive, adventure mode for players, flock data loaded, role allowed), adds to EntityGroup, and elects leader. Leader election prefers: (1) the entity with LEADER type from persistence, (2) players always become leader, (3) first joiner. When a member leaves or dies, the system re-elects from remaining members using canBecomeLeader (players or NPCs with role.isCanLeadFlock()).
join_conditions: Players must be in Adventure mode
Flock PersistentFlockData must be loaded (leader present)
Entity's role must be in the flock's allowed roles list
Only one player can be in a flock at a time
leader_election: NPCs with role.isCanLeadFlock() = true are eligible
When leader unloads, an INTERIM_LEADER is appointed from remaining members
When leader is removed, a new LEADER is elected from eligible members
If no eligible leader exists, the flock is dissolved
dissolution_rules: Flock is removed when size drops below 2 members
Flock is removed when no eligible leader can be found
On removal: all members have FlockMembership stripped, EntityGroup dissolved

flock_behavior.overview: BodyMotionFlock implements classic boids-style flocking: cohesion (move toward group center), separation (avoid nearby members), and leader-following (move toward leader). The GroupSteeringAccumulator iterates over flock members within the influence range, computing sum-of-positions, sum-of-velocities, and sum-of-distances vectors.

group_damage_tracking.overview: Flock maintains double-buffered DamageData for both the whole group and leader-only. Each tick, buffers are swapped and the next buffer is reset. DamageData tracks: most-damaging attacker, most-damaged victim, kill events.
data_tracked: getMostDamagingAttacker() — returns entity that dealt most damage
getMostDamagedVictim() — returns entity that received most damage

flock_behavior.messaging: ActionFlockBeacon sends named messages with optional target references to all flock members (or leader only) via BeaconSupport.postMessage(). Messages have configurable expiration time.

stored_flock.purpose: Serializable container for persisting flock NPC entities when a spawn marker deactivates. Stores NPCs as Holder<EntityStore> arrays. Used by SpawnMarkerEntity to save/restore NPCs when players leave deactivation range.
operations: storeNPCs(refs, store) — removes entities from store, saves as holders
restoreNPCs(output, store) — re-adds entities to store from saved holders
